HBM4 Memory Specification:
- Data rate: 6.4 Gbps/pin (target), up to 8.0 Gbps/pin
- Bus width: 2048-bit per stack (doubled from 1024-bit in HBM3e)
- Bandwidth per stack: ~1.6 - 2.0 TB/s (12-high / 16-high)
- Capacity per stack: 36GB (12-high), 48GB (16-high)
- I/O voltage: 1.1V / 0.9V logic base die
- Base die: FinFET/CMOS 4nm/3nm custom logic die with BIST and test logic
- Power efficiency: ~30% better than HBM3e (pJ/bit)
- Availability: 2026 sampling, 2027 HVM
- Key features: Lower power, higher bandwidth, ECC support, direct chip-on-wafer bonding

HBM3e Memory Specification:
- Data rate: 8.0 - 9.6 Gbps/pin
- Bandwidth per stack: ~1.0 - 1.2 TB/s (12-high, 1024-bit)
- Capacity per stack: 24GB (12-high), 36GB (16-high)
- I/O voltage: 1.1V
- Stack height: 8-high, 12-high, 16-high
- Availability: High volume production 2024+
- Used in: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 (8 stacks = 192GB at 8 TB/s)

HBM3 Memory Specification:
- Data rate: 6.4 Gbps/pin
- Bandwidth per stack: ~819 GB/s (12-high, 1024-bit)
- Capacity per stack: 16GB (8-high), 24GB (12-high)
- I/O voltage: 1.1V
- Stack height: 8-high or 12-high
- Availability: High volume production 2022+
- Used in: NVIDIA Hopper H100 (5 active stacks = 80GB at 3.35 TB/s)
